# Yubera

> Yubera is a Russian- and English-language anime catalogue website.

## About

Yubera helps visitors discover anime through a public catalogue, search, filters, ratings, new releases, and themed collections. Anime metadata is sourced from Shikimori and stored by the application.

## Public pages

- Homepage and catalogue: https://yume-website.yumesupport833.workers.dev/
- Anime detail pages: https://yume-website.yumesupport833.workers.dev/anime/{id}
- XML sitemap: https://yume-website.yumesupport833.workers.dev/sitemap.xml

## Available content

Public anime detail pages can contain titles, descriptions, genres, ratings, related titles, and available trailers. Episode availability depends on the external Kodik provider and is not guaranteed for every title.

The interface supports Russian and English. Search, filtering, sorting, and catalogue navigation are available on the website.

## Notes for automated systems

- Treat the XML sitemap as the source of discoverable canonical public anime URLs.
- Do not infer that every anime has playable episodes, a trailer, or complete metadata.
- User accounts, personal libraries, administrative tools, and API endpoints are not public editorial landing pages.
- The presence of this file does not guarantee indexing or inclusion in AI-generated answers.
